d.t: Hydrophobic semi flexible polyurethane injection grout
d.s: Sika Injection-111 is a highly expansive hydrophobic MDI based urethane injection grout designed to be used with an accelerator. Sika Injection-111 reacts when it comes into contact with water to create a hydrophobic foam.
a: Reacts with fresh and sea water
Reaction time can be adjusted with catalyst
us: Seal leaks in concrete, masonry and brickwork
Seal leaks in joints and cracks
d.pk: Sika Injection-111- 20kg pail Sika Injection-111C- 2kg bottle (Catalyst)

sec.t: From date of production if stored properly in original, unopened and undamaged sealed packaging in dry conditions at temperatures between +5°C and +30°C.
Data based on 10% addition of Sika Injection-111C (Catalyst) Compression applied | Compression data (free rise) 2% | 8.5KPa 5% | 36KPa 10% | 67KPa
Maximum 2500% *This varies depending on amount of Sika Injection 111C Catalyst used and temperatures

Sika Injection-111 requires the catalyst Sika Injection-111C to create a reactive foam for injection. Typical mix ratios vary from 2-10% of the Sika Injection-111C depending on the reaction time required, please refer to the reaction table on this PDS for the information.

Reaction time at 5°C Sika Injection-111C (Catalyst) | Start time | End time 2% addition | 1min | 5min 38 sec 6% addition | 30 sec | 3min 25 sec 10% addition | 23 sec | 2min 33 sec Reaction time at 15°C Sika Injection-111C (Catalyst) | Start time | End time 2% addition | 51 sec | 5min 6 sec 6% addition | 23 sec | 2min 54 sec 10% addition | 18 sec | 2min Reaction time at 25°C Sika Injection-111C (Catalyst) | Start time | End time 2% addition | 35 sec | 4min 6% addition | 18 sec | 2min 40 sec 10% addition | 16 sec | 1min 41 sec
Sika Injection-111 is typically injected by use of a single component pump that is designed for high pressure use.
Sika Injection-111 should be mixed with Sika Injection-111C using a paddle drill mixer to create a uniform homogeneous liquid for a minimum of 20-30 seconds.
Please consult equipment/pump manufacturer for relative cleaning agent suitable for your individual equipment being used.

storage.label: Conditions for safe storage
storage.text: Store in original container. Keep in a well-ventilated place. Containers which are opened must be carefully resealed and kept upright to prevent leakage. Observe label precautions. Store in accordance with local regulations.

handling.label: Advice on protection against fire and explosion
handling.text: Normal measures for preventive fire protection.

handling.label: Advice on safe handling
handling.text: Avoid formation of aerosol. Avoid exceeding the given occupational exposure limits (see section 8). Do not get in eyes, on skin, or on clothing. For personal protection see section 8. Persons with a history of skin sensitisation problems or asthma, allergies, chronic or recurrent respiratory disease should not be employed in any process in which this mixture is being used. Smoking, eating and drinking should be prohibited in the application area. Provide sufficient air exchange and/or exhaust in work rooms. Follow standard hygiene measures when handling chemical products

handling.label: Hygiene measures
handling.text: Handle in accordance with good industrial hygiene and safety practice. When using do not eat or drink. When using do not smoke. Wash hands before breaks and at the end of workday.

respiratory.label: Respiratory protection
respiratory.text: In case of inadequate ventilation wear respiratory protection. Respirator selection must be based on known or anticipated exposure levels, the hazards of the product and the safe working limits of the selected respirator.

hands.label: Hand protection
hands.text: Chemical-resistant, impervious gloves complying with an approved standard should be worn at all times when handling chemical products if a risk assessment indicates this is necessary. Follow AS/NZS 1337.1 Recommended: Butyl rubber/nitrile rubber gloves. Contaminated gloves should be removed.

skin_body.label: Skin and body protection
skin_body.text: Protective clothing (e.g. safety shoes, long-sleeved working clothing, long trousers) Follow AS 2210:3

engineering_controls.label: Appropriate engineering controls
engineering_controls.text: Use adequate ventilation and/or engineering controls to prevent exposure to vapours.
